title: The Day a Change of Covered Value Takes Effect From on a Protection Plan
content:
Where the covered value of a Pass and Trip Protection plan is brought onto the price the covered holding's own
record shows, the day the change takes effect from is settled as follows.

1. Where an entry for a move up of tier stands on the covered holding's Season Pass Programme account for the
   season, and the plan does not stand out of force for non-payment, the change takes effect from the day that
   entry was raised on the covered holding's account.
2. Where no entry for a move up of tier stands on the covered holding's account for the season, and the plan
   does not stand out of force for non-payment, the change takes effect from the day it is recorded on the
   plan.
3. In every other case the change takes effect from the day cover began.

**Put as a matter of what the records show.** The first question is whether the covered holding's account
carries, within the season the plan covers, an entry raised for a move up of tier. The second is whether the
plan itself stands out of force for non-payment. The two together settle which of the three days above is the
day the change takes effect from; a plan standing out of force for non-payment takes the day cover began
whether or not such an entry stands on the covered holding's account.

**Condition table (hypothetical inputs).**

| An entry for a move up of tier stands on the covered holding's account this season | The plan stands out of force for non-payment | The change takes effect from |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes | No | The day that entry was raised on the covered holding's account |
| No | No | The day the change is recorded on the plan |
| Yes | Yes | The day cover began |
| No | Yes | The day cover began |
